applicant.organisation: Department of Pharmacology, Medical University of Innsbruck

purpose: We study the harms of e-cigarettes and heated tobacco in people with diabetes to inform clinical advice; we need regional prevalence to select study regions.
question: How many adults have type 2 diabetes, per region?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Type 2 diabetes = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with E11.
Report per region: adults with type 2 diabetes.
